title: The Space Journal
customRequest: Create a cinematic, image-led space journal with a dramatic cover, clear story hierarchy, an explainer page, a timeline, source notes and a strong closing page. Use only Data-Collection-screened NASA imagery and retain visible credits and usage notes.

customRequestReceipt.note: At least one full lead-feature page, source notes and a closing page are preserved. Optional sections may be omitted when needed to meet the requested page count.
customRequestReceipt.engineLimitation: This no-AI build applies supported layout/section directives only. It does not rewrite story copy in a requested voice or independently corroborate every factual claim; source provenance comes from the Publisher's official-source policy. Unsupported directions are listed above rather than claimed as applied.
